result.reason: The operative language does not reach even the fallback cleanly. Although it adds a mutual 12-month-fee cap and states that indirect/consequential damages are excluded mutually, it retains extensive one-sided Licensor immunities, risk assumptions, and exclusions that conflict with and undermine that mutual framework. It also leaves the express infringement immunity intact, makes only Licensor's indemnification obligations uncapped, and omits the preferred USD 1 million floor, data-protection carve-out, IP-infringement carve-out, and payment-obligations clarification. The margin comment proposes deleting the conflicting liability stack, but those deletions are not reflected in the operative clause. The result is internally inconsistent, unnecessarily duplicative, and not professionally integrated.
